title: Returned-Payment Fee and the Bluegate AutoPay Authorization on a Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement
content:
**Rule.** The returned-payment fee on a Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement carries an AutoPay share read from the agreement's Bluegate AutoPay Authorization:

- where Bluegate **suspended** that authorization within the 90 days up to the handling date, the tenant pays **50 percent** of the fee;
- where the **tenant cancelled** that authorization within those 90 days, the tenant pays **75 percent**;
- in every other case the fee is charged in full.

The share multiplies the fee before the product is rounded to the cent, half up. The authorization is the Bluegate AutoPay Authorization drafting this rental agreement; its status (suspended, or cancelled on the tenant's revocation), its suspension date and its cancellation date are read from that authorization record. The 90 days run back from the handling date, the day 90 days before it included.

## Combinations

| Authorization record | Date within the 90 days | Share paid |
|---|---|---|
| suspended by Bluegate | suspension date within | 50% |
| cancelled by the tenant | cancellation date within | 75% |
| suspended or cancelled | date earlier than the 90 days | full fee |
| active, or no authorization | — | full fee |

## Hypothetical dates (handling date 1 July 2027)

- Suspension dated 2 April 2027, 90 days earlier: within the window, 50 percent.
- Suspension dated 1 April 2027, 91 days earlier: outside the window, full fee.
- Tenant cancellation dated 15 June 2027: 75 percent; a limited fee of $30.00 becomes $22.50.
